$Comment: The gloves of the disenchanter's kit, one of four cloth pieces paid only by the chance rolls in Lootables/Disenchant_Kit.json. A standalone copy of the vanilla silk gloves (Armor_Cloth_Silk_Hands): the same art, Health and Mana lines and cloth resistances, at Uncommon quality; no Parent and no Recipe, so no crafting or salvage recipe rides along, and the iron-parent leaves (Categories, the Block animation set, DurabilityLossOnHit, the EquipItem Interactions) are spelled out. Its own Disenchanting Proficiency is the smallest of the four; the set file (ZiggfreedCommon/GearSets/RPG_Disenchanters_Kit.json) adds the tier bonuses. Family Disenchanter keeps it off the tables as input.
